name: Standing Torso Rotation
steps: Stand tall with your feet slightly wider than shoulder-width, knees softly unlocked, and arms held bent across your chest or relaxed out to your sides.
Brace your core lightly and rotate your shoulders and rib cage smoothly to one side while allowing your opposite heel to pivot gently if comfortable.
Swing smoothly back through center and rotate to the opposite side in a controlled, rhythmic arc.
Continue alternating sides fluidly for the target duration.
tips: Keep the motion smooth and controlled rather than whipping your spine violently at the end ranges.
Maintain tall posture and let your eyes follow your shoulders gently.
